title: Tough
lines: Not All Spare Balls Are Created Equal!
We developed our latest coverstock formulation with one thought in mind: durability. Our new Polythane cover offers the performance of a polyester ball with the durability of a urethane ball.
This is the traditional core design found in the typical spare ball, but with carbon fiber added. It features a high RG and low differential to keep flare and hook potential low.
FACTORY FINISH 500/1000 Abralon Polished w/ Powerhouse Factory Finish Polish
